text:
### API Security  
**API Gateway (Kong):**
- Authentication (API key + JWT)
- Rate limiting (prevent abuse)
- Request validation (prevent injection)
- Monitoring and alerting  
**API Design:**
- Input validation (sanitize all inputs)
- Output encoding (prevent XSS)
- Authorization checks (role-based)
- Audit logging of API calls

raw_entities.name: API Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal set of security standards governing the implementation and design of APIs at FirstUK Bank, focusing on gateway controls and secure design principles.

raw_entities.name: Kong API Gateway
raw_entities.description: The primary technical gateway used to enforce authentication, rate limiting, and request validation for API traffic.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory API Authentication
raw_entities.description: Requirement that API access must be secured using a combination of API keys and JSON Web Tokens (JWT).

raw_entities.name: API Rate Limiting Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement rate limiting on the API Gateway to prevent system abuse.

raw_entities.name: API Request Validation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to validate incoming requests at the gateway level to prevent injection attacks.

raw_entities.name: API Monitoring and Alerting
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain monitoring and alerting capabilities for API Gateway activity.

raw_entities.name: API Input Sanitization
raw_entities.description: Design requirement to sanitize all inputs to ensure secure API processing.

raw_entities.name: API Output Encoding
raw_entities.description: Design requirement to encode outputs to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.

raw_entities.name: Role-Based API Authorization
raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement authorization checks based on user or system roles.

raw_entities.name: API Call Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain audit logs of all API calls for security and compliance tracking.

raw_entities.name: API Abuse
raw_entities.description: The risk of API resources being overwhelmed or misused, mitigated by rate limiting.

raw_entities.name: Injection Attack
raw_entities.description: The risk of malicious code being injected into API requests, mitigated by request validation.

raw_entities.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
raw_entities.description: The risk of malicious scripts being executed in a user's browser via API outputs, mitigated by output encoding.

raw_entities.name: Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: The operational mechanism of recording API calls to provide a traceable history of system access.
